description: This Java file defines an Android Fragment class named DataFragment used in a wearable device data layer sample. The fragment manages a list of data items received from a paired phone, inflates a layout, and provides methods to append data items to the list.

classes.name: DataFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of DataItems received from the phone, providing UI to show and append data items.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes list view and adapter, and sets up the view hierarchy.

methods.name: appendItem
methods.description: Adds a new data item with the specified title and text to the list, hiding the intro text if necessary.
